What do the evidence labels mean?

Labels preserve each original record’s status. A specification describes a proposed mechanism; a finite computation establishes a result for its declared inputs; an illustrative model visualizes a relationship; an empirical finding depends on its recorded observations. Open a full record to inspect its original qualification and sources.

    Research addendum · Ambiance, 279 proposals & REST custody

    Ambiance is Dome-World's modeled local cognitive weather: fold density, storm risk, humidity, visibility, and relation among local sections. Weather is a bounded rendering of the model, never proof of a total field or external authority.

    279 retained research candidates are classified without retroactively changing original statuses. Eleven typed formal/implementation results are distinguished from ten research protocols and sixteen held model or empirical claims; all remaining candidates retain their original source status. REST-08–REST-12-EXIT outcomes are source-scoped; REST-01–07 exact stage receipts remain unverified.
